### Are You a Doer of the Word?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-october-23-2022.html
Passage: James 1:22
Points:
- Hearing God's Word without obeying it leads to self-deception.
- People often admire or appreciate preaching while failing to recognize the message is meant for them personally.
- True faith requires heeding and applying Scripture rather than merely listening to it.
- Christians should seek practical ways to translate biblical truth into daily action.

### Sometimes I’ve Been Quick to Speak and Slow to Listen
Author: Anne Peterson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-january-23.html
Passage: James 1:19
Points:
- Rushing to speak leads to hasty reactions instead of compassionate, gracious responses.
- Taking time to listen communicates to others that they are valued and that their thoughts matter.
- Pride often tempts people to defend their words rather than humble themselves and ask for forgiveness.
- Growing into Christlikeness involves letting go of the need to be right and learning to listen well.
